count_scope: New independent review work only. Raw sources and screenshots were reused, not newly researched/captured. Search calls include two queries in one search tool call and one primary-page open. Counts are activity units usable for scenarios, not tokens or invoices.

unavailable_measurements.reason: Session did not expose measured token usage, per-call billing or a complete tool meter.

cost_scenario_rule: Apply explicit user-visible token-per-review/search/read assumptions to these activity counts if estimating; label all such totals scenario assumptions. Never replace actual_tokens or actual_billed_usd null with scenario output.
